answer: Noted — I'll remember that library crates should use `thiserror` and binaries should use `anyhow` (never the reverse) for future work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use thiserror for their error types, and binaries must use anyhow for theirs — never the reverse (library using anyhow or binary using thiserror).
The convention of library crates using thiserror and binaries using anyhow was established because violating it caused problems twice in this codebase.
